top_signals.title: Trump Family-Linked Bitcoin Miner Posts Second-Quarter Loss
top_signals.summary: American Bitcoin Corp., the Trump family-backed miner launched last year just before the cryptocurrency tumbled from record highs, posted a third consecutive quarterly loss after a decline in the value of its holdings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
